title: アタシのタイマン、アンタのタイマン

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!
A few weeks have passed since Hishi Amazon and I promised to give the Tiara tour everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant! Argh, this is killin' me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: No, I can't throw in the towel!
Hishi Amazon has bounced back from the scrimmage, putting her heart and soul into her training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, that's that for today's training schedule. Now…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You can go home first if you want, Teach! I'm gonna run a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Raaaahhh!
However, everything she confessed and declared that day was very much genuine—that much I know for sure.
Right now, she's doing all she can to become the best version of herself—to become a Hishi Amazon who is strong and confident.
choice_data_list: (There's only one thing I can do for her.)

text_block_list.text: I once again pour time into researching Hishi Amazon's running technique in order to support her to the fullest as her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew! What a beautiful morning! You ready to get this show on the road?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's wrong?! You're swayin' on your feet like a pendulum!
I hand over the results of my studies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm, what's this notebook? "Training Notes for Hishi Amazon"?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "In order to use Hishi Amazon's abilities to the fullest, focus on building muscular strength to support her explosive bursts of speed."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Strengthen the quadriceps, sartorius, and adductor muscles using progressive overload…"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Strengthen fast-twitch muscles by introducing a new diet based on sports nutrition and routine mountain trail runs, which double as recreation"…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, interesting… Huh! Hahaha, oh wow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I couldn't write somethin' this good with all the help in the world. Thanks a lot, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll put this to use right away and follow these training methods today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And you should get some sleep! You're not gonna be any good here with those panda eyes!
So begin our days of training using the booklet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Third lap, finished! Wheeze…
choice_data_list: You've got this, only one more to go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hrraagh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I hate sitting still for so long! I get that it's important to learn about nutrition and stuff, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I can't believe you're able to read for so long. That stuff's dense, too…
choice_data_list: I just want to do what I can to help.
I just want to do what I can to help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah! You sure know what to say, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Library Assistant
text_block_list.text: Please keep quiet in the library.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, my bad…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Grraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where'd Teach go?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Hey, you look beat! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec, this is my training. Why don't you go take the cable car up instead?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What're you talkin' about?
choice_data_list: I don't want anything to happen to you.
I don't want anything to happen to you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon… You're such a worrywart. I'll give you a piggyback, so hop on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hiking was gettin' too easy for me. Using you as training weight will help mix things up!
We continue to work hard together, training day after day…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant… How was that, Teach? What was my time?
When I check my stopwatch, I'm thrilled to see what a big improvement she's made.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Booyah!
Without thinking, I write her time down in large numbers in my booklet. She's going to do great if she keeps this up!
choice_data_list: Let's keep going full steam ahead!

text_block_list.text: I begin thinking of what kind of changes I'll have to make to her training regimen to keep up with her new record time.
choice_data_list: Just as I'm pondering what we need to do to turn things up a notch…

text_block_list.text: I lock eyes with Hishi Amazon, who has apparently been staring at me intently.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry 'bout that. It's nothing major.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's just… I thought that the Twinkle Series was my one-on-one, and mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was gonna blast my way through, pickin' whatever fights I wanted—winning all the glory for myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But after takin' a step back and really looking at things, I realize you're just as determined to win as I am.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Once I realized that, I…
She smiles bashfully.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I finally saw that you're in this fight with me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Knowin' that my partner's really puttin' in the work from the shadows… Well, it doesn't feel too bad.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Argh, I can't do this sappy stuff! Anyway, what training have you got for me?!
It won't be long till the Oka Sho is upon us.
